messages:
Lina: Heads-up — planning a short rollout of runtime v3.9 to prod tomorrow 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. Keeping it staged: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100%. Quick async runbook and rollcall here, please confirm availability and owners for smoke + rollback.

Alex: I can own the smoke checks for the first canary (15:00–15:25 UTC). Will run the smoke script and health checks.

Maria: I can own rollback and feature-flag gating. I'll be online 14:45–16:00 UTC. I'll also toggle LaunchDarkly if needed.

Raj: I'll monitor metrics, traces, and alert thresholds. Available 14:50–16:10 UTC. Will mute non-critical alerts.

Lina: Quick checklist (async):
- [ ] Production DB snapshot / backups taken (ops-bot)
- [ ] Canary lane A (10%) deployed to pod group a1 — Alex
- [ ] Run smoke script and basic verifications — Alex
- [ ] Monitor p95 and error rate for 10m window — Raj
- [ ] If OK, promote to 50% — Lina/ops-bot
- [ ] Rollback strategy confirmed (owner + command) — Maria
- [ ] Final promote to 100% after 30m stable — Lina

Alex: Smoke script I'll run: `./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env=prod --canary=a1`
Quick manual checks after deploy:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status
# expect: "ok"
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/metrics?range=5m | jq '.latency.p95'
# expect < 250
```

Maria: Rollback plan (keeps it simple):
- If errors spike or p95 > 400ms for 10m, rollback canary: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod --to-revision=42`
- If partial issues, flip LD flag `redwood_runtime_v3_9` -> `off` for canary cohort via LaunchDarkly.

Raj: Monitoring thresholds I'll watch:
- p95 latency > 350ms for 10m -> investigate
- 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m -> immediate rollback recommended
- SLO error budget burn > 30% in 15m -> alert

ops-bot: Backup snapshot: job `db-snapshot-prod` completed at 2026-03-18T13:10:02Z. ID: snap-20260318-1310

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started to pod group a1 at 2026-03-18T15:00:12Z (10% traffic). Image: runtime:v3.9-rc4

Alex: Canary is up. Running smoke now. Running 200 requests across endpoints (~1 min).

Alex: Smoke run result: 200/200 OK, sample p95 178ms, 5xx=0.1%. Logs show a couple of 429s during startup - investigating but seems transient.

Raj: Seeing slight increase in tail latencies but within threshold. No new alerts. Traces look fine.

Lina: If everyone agrees, we'll nudge to 50% in 10m and re-check. If anyone has objections now speak up.

Maria: No objections. Standby to toggle flag or run rollback command if needed.

Lina: Promoting to 50% at 15:10 UTC. ops-bot will execute.

ops-bot: Promotion executed: traffic routing updated (10% -> 50%) at 2026-03-18T15:10:05Z.

Alex: Running quick full-smoke again against 50% cohort.

Alex: Smoke result at 15:15:20 — 500/500 OK, p95 190ms, 5xx 0.15%.

Raj: Metrics steady. Watching error budget closely. All green for now.

Lina: Final decision timeline: wait 25m, if no regressions promote to 100% at ~15:40 UTC. Maria ready to rollback on signal.

Maria: Ready. If we need to rollback I'll run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod --to-revision=41` and flip LD flag.

Alex: I'll keep smoke script running on a 5m cadence until final promote.

Raj: I'll keep the monitoring dashboard pinned and post updates here if any threshold hits.

Lina: Thanks all. Final async sign-offs: please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm ownership/time windows.

Alex: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:

Lina: Noted — will post final promote and completion messages in this thread. If any rollback occurs, we will reopen an incident channel.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% executed at 2026-03-18T15:40:12Z. All routes updated.

Alex: Post-promote quick check: 1000 requests sample p95 195ms, 5xx 0.18%. No anomalies seen in the first 5m.

Raj: Dashboards look clear. Closing monitoring window after 30m stable.

Lina: Rollout complete. Thanks team. We'll capture notes in the release doc and postmortem if needed.
